name: ZX_PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_STG
description: This table stores party tax profile details that need to be imported into party tax profile table.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Batch name to identify the set of records to be processed

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Party number used to identify the party

columns.name: PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Party name used to identify the party

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Party type code associated with the record such as THIRD_PARTY,etc.

columns.name: ROUNDING_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Rounding level code to be used for rounding of taxes calculated for a party tax profile.

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rounding rule code to be used for rounding taxes. Possible values are UP, DOWN and NEAREST.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Default tax classification code for this party tax profile

columns.name: SUPPLIER_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this party tax profile is for a third party supplier

columns.name: CUSTOMER_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this party tax profile is for a third party customer

columns.name: PROCESS_FOR_APPLICABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicates whether taxes should be automatically calculated  for this party tax profile.

columns.name: INCLUSIVE_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether transaction line amounts include tax amount  for this party tax profile. This column is applicable for only suppliers.

columns.name: ALLOW_OFFSET_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Allow offset taxes for this party tax profile.

columns.name: RECORD_STATUS
columns.description:
Gives the validation status of the record being processed:
NULL - only these records will be picked up for processing by program
0 - record picked up by concurrent program for validation
1 - all id validated
2 - successful record
3 - error record

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: LOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request status of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRANSPORT_PRVDR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the party is a transportation provider such as freight carrier.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code used to validate the tax registration number for this party tax profile.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate registration type.

columns.name: REP_REGISTRATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Tax registration number for this party tax profile. This column is applicable only for suppliers, customers and first party legal establishments.

columns.name: TAX_GROSS_NET_FLAG
columns.description: Transaction tax applicability on the gross or net amount indicator.

columns.name: WHT_GROSS_NET_FLAG
columns.description: Withholding tax applicability on the gross or net amount indicator.
